chunks: Whatever is in it from Habib ibn al-Mu'alla, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid al-Khazzaz, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Habib ibn al-Mu'alla al-Khath'ami.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; the immediate source in the compiler's sanad.
key_terms.الْخَثْعَمِيِّ: A tribal attribution identifying Habib ibn al-Mu'alla.
key_terms.الْخَزَّازِ: An identifying epithet of Muhammad ibn al-Walid in the chain.
key_terms.حَبِيبِ بْنِ الْمُعَلّٰى: A transmitter from whom narrations in this section are reported.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct reporting by the compiler through his chain.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Habib ibn al-Mu'alla in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage gives the transmission chain for reports narrated from Habib ibn al-Mu'alla in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting the sanad through which the author received these hadith, linking them through named transmitters back to Habib ibn al-Mu'alla al-Khath'ami.
